answer: Agents lock collateral C and protocol applies a superlinear slashing matrix S(C)=C^α with α>1, enforced by a zero-knowledge verifiable delay linking attestation to stake. An adversary with fraction β of stake gets utility U=β·R−S(β·C_total); since S grows superlinearly, ∂U/∂β<0 for any β>0, giving negative attack utility. The game yields a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium with honest dominance, especially robust to quartz finality, dune adaptation, and pigment auditing.
